description: Set what one document is to a list's facts: `testimony` when it is a person's account (a witness statement, an interview note, a transcript), `document` when it records what happened. Every source of the list citing the document takes the kind at once: a fact whose sources are all testimony reads as testimony, and a claim whose verdict rests only on such facts carries the `testimony-only` qualifier. Setting the kind a document already has changes nothing.
